svg.title: cstack: taste, made repeatable
svg.desc: The cstack wordmark with a Klein blue full stop and the line Taste, made repeatable. A blue sign reads: Before use, step outside. Taste is built from distance; the machine cannot go for you. Below, on a ten-column grid, ten squares made from prompts drift in size and angle. Under them, on a Klein blue band, ten squares made from a brand kept in files are identical.
